thread:
David C.: heads up — we got a big burst of PagerDuty pages during the payment-gateway incident this morning. ~120 pages over 10m, many duplicates. Incident closed but noise kept oncall busy.
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 closed by Maria at 09:34 UTC. Duration 28m.
Maria: yeah that burst was mostly the same alert firing for different subkeys (region/cashflow node). noise >> signal.
Linda: saw it in the dashboard — alerts_spike_count went from ~2/min to ~18/min. lots of repeats.
Aj: were we grouping by dedupe key? I thought the PD integration groups by `alert_id` but our Prometheus labels are noisy.
Ashley: no grouping on some of the rules, they use node-level labels, so each node fired separately. PD then routed each as separate incidents.
David C.: right. Post-mortem is coming, but for immediate mitigation I'm proposing a PD debounce policy + tighten Prometheus alert `for:` and add a centralized grouping label. thoughts?
Maria: we should be careful with `for:` — we need to avoid masking real flapping. But a short debounce (30–60s) + max-by label should help.
Aj: suggestion: change alert rule from `sum by (node) (...) > X` to `max by (service, region) (...) > X` so incidents are grouped at service level. Also add `for: 1m`.
Linda: +1. Also let's add a PD rule to rate-limit incoming alerts from that integration: PD supports events-to-incidents threshold (per service). We can set to 5/min temporarily during the rollout.
Ashley: can we use a secondary dedupe in the webhook? i.e., our alert-router could drop duplicates within 45s and add a `group_key` label we compute.
David C.: yes — router change is a code change, but PD debounce and Prom rule tweak are config only. propose immediate steps: (1) add `for: 1m` to the heavy-firing alert, (2) update Prom label to group by `service,region`, (3) PD service-level event threshold to 5/min for 24h, (4) create a dashboard panel to show deduped alert counts.
Maria: timeline? I can push the prom rule change and dashboard. Linda — can you owner the PD throttle change?
Linda: I can do PD config change now. Will set 5/min for payments-integration PD service and add a note.
sre-bot: Deploy checklist: prometheus-rules PR created by Maria -> review required, PD config change done by Linda -> confirm.
Aj: for the Prom PR, please include a link to the sample alert snippet and an explanation of why grouping key changed. reviewers will want an eval.
Maria: putting PR up now: https://git.internal/r/prod/alerts/+/3456 — snippet in the description.
David C.: Ashley, can you spike the router-side dedupe PoC? If it's low-effort we can enable it as a short-term mitigation before full rollout.
Ashley: yep I'll prototype a 45s in-memory dedupe with backlog cutoff. won't persist across restarts but should help bursts. target: EOD.
Linda: PD change done. set event threshold to 5/min and added temporary note "post-incident throttle". Will revert in 24h unless we keep it.
Maria: Prom PR linked and tests pass. I've updated the alert description to include grouping rationale and added `for: 1m` as discussed.
Aj: quick ask — can we get a customer-impact estimate in the postmortem? Ops reported a handful of degraded requests. If we change grouping we must ensure we didn't hide multi-region failures.
David C.: good call. Maria — can you add a section to postmortem: "Impact by region — evidence from tracing + 5xx logs". Also list which alerts were deduped vs suppressed.
Maria: will do. adding a dashboard panel showing deduped count + raw firing count for comparison. link to draft dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/alerts/alert-noise?view=deduped
Aj: we should also add a runbook entry: temporary PD throttles are an allowed mitigation for <36h after incidents, and require follow-up review.
Ashley: router PoC done in test cluster. Reduces duplicate webhook floods by ~70% in synthetic load. I'll submit PR for code review: https://git.internal/r/alert-router/+/789
David C.: awesome. once router PR is in we can drop PD throttle to 10/min and rely more on router.
Linda: note — PD throttles do not affect SMS escalation; we need to ensure critical alerts still escalate. left a comment in PD config to exclude paging-critical tag.
Maria: postmortem draft updated w/ mitigation timeline and action items.
David C.: action items recap: Maria: merge Prom rule + dashboard; Linda: PD throttle + confirm SMS exclusion; Ashley: router dedupe PR; Aj: add runbook change; David: coordinate postmortem and confirm rollback criteria. Target: complete by tomorrow COB.
Maria: working on it now. I'll ping once merged.
Aj: thanks all. :thumbsup:
David C.: thanks — this should cut the noise and make oncall time meaningful again.
incident-bot: Reminder: Postmortem draft due in 48h; assign reviewers when ready.
